groupsSteps.title: Your Padel trip in simple steps
groupsSteps.subtitle: Planning your ultimate Padel adventure with Vibra Travel is easy. Here's how to make it happen.
groupsSteps.step1Desc: Share your preferred location, group size, ideal dates, padel goals, and the cultural experiences you're interested in. Whether it's wine tastings, coastal hikes, or competitive matchplay—we'll shape it around you. The more you share, the better!
groupsSteps.step2Desc: We will create a fully personalised package tailored specifically to your group's preferences, skill levels, and interests. Whether you want more court time, cultural experiences, or a mix of both, we'll design a seamless plan that fits your unique vision and ensures an unforgettable trip.
groupsSteps.step3Desc: With everything arranged, all that's left is for you to immerse yourselves in the Padel action and Spanish charm. Get ready for an unforgettable Vibra trip!

readyAdventure.description: At Vibra Travel, we're passionate about creating Padel holidays that go beyond the ordinary. We combine our love for the game with deep local knowledge of Spain to deliver experiences you'll talk about for years.

items.quote: Every detail was handled, from court bookings to tapas nights. The padel was excellent, but the local experiences made the trip feel completely personal.

items.quote: Our team wanted something active but easy to organise. Vibra built the perfect mix of coaching, matches, dinners, and time to enjoy the city together.
